game_concept: A speed quiz set in Mystic Forest – Root Tunnels, tunnels among huge roots: the fairy gardener must handle wasp swarms while practicing control flow: for loops. Core idea – Iteration Tracer: Predict how many times a loop body runs before the clock stops.
theme: Mystic Forest – Root Tunnels: tunnels among huge roots
core_gameplay_loop: In Root Tunnels, repeat each round: Predict how many times a loop body runs before the clock stops. Each round, a new mana petals challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the trace_score value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Collect 460 points of mana petals by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 460, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 5 – Control Flow: For Loops | Level 10 (extended tier): Iteration Tracer
assets_style: lush pixel-art forest: dense green canopy, a glowing blue ancient tree, winding streams and dirt paths; flat Kenney-style sprites; airy flutes, birdsong and soft magical chimes
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Iteration Tracer' (Week 5 slot 12), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Root Tunnels'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mystic Forest
region.mood: airy flutes, birdsong and soft magical chimes

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how trace_score changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against wasp swarms in Root Tunnels.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 460 within 57 seconds.
